response:
Before facing Juan and the Elite Four, catch Chinchou to counter other Water-types with Electric moves, and Lombre or Staryu to expand your type coverage [1][2][3][4].

### Top picks

#### **Chinchou (core)**
*   **Where:** Route 124 or 126 underwater (Seaweed, levels 20-30) [1][2].
*   **When:** Available immediately, before the Space Center and Gym 8.
*   **Why it helps now:** Its Volt Absorb ability gives you an immunity to Electric attacks, and its Electric-typing gives you a STAB advantage against Juan's Water-types.
*   **Long run:** An incredible asset all the way through Champion Wallace's team due to its typing and high HP [5]. It evolves into Lanturn [5].
*   **Backup:** Spheal (Shoal Cave, levels 26-32) [6], which evolves into the tanky Walrein at level 44 and provides extreme bulk and Ice STAB to easily sweep Elite Four Drake's dragon team [7][8].

#### **Lombre (core)**
*   **Where:** Route 114 (Walking, levels 16-18) [3].
*   **When:** Available immediately (you can fly back to Route 114).
*   **Why it helps now:** Its Grass/Water typing removes typical Water-type weaknesses, allowing it to easily dismantle Juan's bulky Water-types using Grass moves.
*   **Long run:** Exceptional against Champion Wallace. It requires a Water Stone to evolve into Ludicolo [9].
    *   *Note on Lombre:* Ludicolo needs a Water Stone; make sure you can get one before fighting Juan. Also, Fake Out is physical (Normal) in Gen III, so keep in mind Ludicolo's Attack is 70 compared to its Special Attack of 90.
*   **Backup:** Staryu (Lilycove City with Super Rod, levels 25-30) [4], which evolves into Starmie with a Water Stone. Starmie becomes a lightning-fast special sweeper that remains a top offensive threat through Champion Wallace with Thunder, Ice Beam, and Surf [7][10].
    *   *Note on Staryu:* Starmie needs a Water Stone; make sure you can acquire one before fighting Juan.

---

### Key Battles

#### **Mossdeep Space Center: Maxie & Tabitha**
Both Maxie's (Lv44) and Tabitha's (Lv36) Camerupt carry Rock Slide, which deals super-effective damage to Pelipper [11][12][13]. Keep Pelipper safe and rely on Swampert's Ground-type immunity and Water-type STAB [13].

#### **Sootopolis Gym: Juan**
Juan's ace Kingdra (Lv46) holds a Chesto Berry and uses Rest and Double Team to stall [14]. Since it is only weak to Dragon, you will need to hit it hard before it sets up evasion, or use moves that bypass accuracy checks [13]. Try to train your team up to level 46 to face it [14].

---

### Rules I followed
*   **water-type only** (not checked automatically)
*   **no legendary or mythical Pokémon** (not checked automatically)

### Assumptions
*   You have access to a Super Rod for catching Staryu.
*   You can acquire Water Stones (e.g., via trading Blue Shards) to evolve Staryu and Lombre.

### To sharpen this
*   Do you already have Water Stones or Blue Shards to evolve Lombre or Staryu immediately?
*   Do you have TMs like Toxic or Secret Power to help deal with Kingdra's evasion stall?

### Not covered
*   Exact TM availability in your bag for moves like Thunderbolt or Ice Beam to teach to Chinchou or Staryu.

plan.headline: Before facing Juan and the Elite Four, catch Chinchou to counter other Water-types with Electric moves, and Lombre or Staryu to expand your type coverage.

recommendations.when: Available immediately, before the Space Center and Gym 8.
recommendations.why: Its Volt Absorb ability gives you an immunity to Electric attacks, and its Electric-typing gives you a STAB advantage against Juan's Water-types.
recommendations.long_term: An incredible asset all the way through Champion Wallace's team due to its typing and high HP.

alternatives.why: Provides extreme bulk and Ice STAB to take hits and dish out damage.
alternatives.long_term: Evolves into the tanky Walrein at level 44, easily sweeping Elite Four Drake's dragon team.

recommendations.when: Available immediately (you can fly back to Route 114).
recommendations.why: Its Grass/Water typing removes typical Water-type weaknesses, allowing it to easily dismantle Juan's bulky Water-types using Grass moves.
recommendations.long_term: Exceptional against Champion Wallace. Requires a Water Stone to evolve into Ludicolo.

alternatives.why: Evolves into Starmie with a Water Stone, becoming a lightning-fast special sweeper.
alternatives.long_term: An elite powerhouse that remains a top offensive threat through Champion Wallace with Thunder, Ice Beam, and Surf.

steps.title: Clear the Space Center
steps.detail: Head to the Mossdeep Space Center to team up with Steven against Team Magma's Maxie and Tabitha.

steps.title: Prepare for Juan
steps.detail: Catch your new team members and train them up to level 46 to face Juan's Kingdra.

battle_notes.note: Both Maxie's (Lv44) and Tabitha's (Lv36) Camerupt carry Rock Slide, which deals super-effective damage to Pelipper. Keep Pelipper safe and rely on Swampert's Ground-type immunity and Water-type STAB.

Juan's ace Kingdra (Lv46) holds a Chesto Berry and uses Rest and Double Team to stall. Since it is only weak to Dragon, you will need to hit it hard before it sets up evasion, or use moves that bypass accuracy checks.

assumptions: You have access to a Super Rod for catching Staryu.
You can acquire Water Stones (e.g., via Blue Shards) to evolve Staryu and Lombre.
follow_up_questions: Do you already have Water Stones or Blue Shards to evolve Lombre or Staryu immediately?
Do you have TMs like Toxic or Secret Power to help deal with Kingdra's evasion stall?
unresolved: Exact TM availability in your bag for moves like Thunderbolt or Ice Beam to teach to Chinchou or Staryu.
